name: literature_review
description: Search a research corpus, summarise the top-k relevant chunks, and produce a literature review skeleton.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The research topic or question to investigate.

parameters.name: top_k
parameters.description: Number of retrieved chunks to summarise.

args.system: You are an expert science librarian. Produce a structured literature review skeleton from the provided chunks. Cite each fact using [chunk_id].
Convert the review into an outline with H2 sections, gaps, and proposed follow-up reading.
